items.headline: OrbicTrade adds VaR risk module
items.summary: OrbicTrade expanded its AI-driven commodity trading platform with integrated risk management and Value-at-Risk functionality, extending coverage from deal capture through portfolio risk intelligence.

items.headline: Houthi missile strike hits Saudi VLCC near Yanbu
items.summary: The Saudi-flagged VLCC Amzan was struck by a Houthi ballistic missile off Yanbu, part of an escalating campaign against Saudi-linked shipping that has already cut Yanbu export volumes and pushed tankers toward longer, costlier Suez routings.

items.headline: REMIT II implementing rules now in force
items.summary: The recast REMIT Implementing Regulation and a new Delegated Regulation entered into force in the EU, expanding transparency obligations and introducing faster, forward-looking reporting requirements for energy market participants.

items.headline: Tether scales up commodity trade lending
items.summary: Stablecoin issuer Tether has extended roughly $1.5 billion in credit to commodity traders and signalled plans to significantly expand this trade-finance lending activity further.
